boundary: Startup workflow evidence only. Failed probes receive zero completion, validation, production, authority, or independent-reproduction credit.

incidents.candidate_method: Bind the memory registry to its declared memory-root path before searching.
incidents.failure: The first memory-registry search started from the task metadata directory and therefore found no registry file.
incidents.recovery: Use the exact declared memory-root registry path and keep the initial miss as a retained negative.

incidents.candidate_method: Use ordinary non-force push after a verified fast-forward because push has no ff-only option.
incidents.failure: The lane fast-forward succeeded, but the first push wrapper requested an unsupported ff-only option and made no remote update.
incidents.recovery: Verify the clean intended head and upstream divergence, then use an ordinary explicit refspec push with no force option.

incidents.candidate_method: Pin UTF-8 before Python emits inherited Unicode proposal titles.
incidents.failure: The first bounded novelty keyword probe reached an inherited Māori title and the default Windows console encoding rejected the output.
incidents.recovery: Set PYTHONUTF8 before process start and rerun only the bounded read without altering culturally correct source text.

incidents.candidate_method: Materialize statement-level foreach output before piping in Windows PowerShell 5.1.
incidents.failure: A bounded skill-size inventory piped directly from a foreach statement and failed at parse time before producing evidence.
incidents.recovery: Assign the loop rows to an array and pipe only that array to JSON serialization.

incidents.candidate_method: Select similarity neighbours with an explicit score-only key.
incidents.failure: The first lexical-neighbour probe used tuple maximum selection, so tied scores fell through to incomparable proposal dictionaries.
incidents.recovery: Select the maximum candidate with an explicit key over the numeric similarity field and preserve proposal dictionaries only as payload.

incidents.candidate_method: Assemble diagnostic fields outside nested f-string expressions.
incidents.failure: A bounded keyword audit used an invalid escaped expression inside a nested f-string and stopped at parse time.
incidents.recovery: Build each identifier-and-title fragment with simple field access before joining the diagnostic line.

incidents.candidate_method: Use the verified Windows system-local offset when the optional IANA tzdata package is absent.
incidents.failure: The first x1 builder stopped before artifact generation because Python could not resolve Pacific/Auckland through an unavailable optional tzdata package.
incidents.recovery: Record UTC and the verified Windows system-local New Zealand timestamp using datetime astimezone, and record the Windows timezone name separately.

incidents.candidate_method: Invoke non-package tests through exact unittest discovery.
incidents.failure: The first x1 test invocation addressed the tests directory as an importable package, so unittest failed before discovering the file.
incidents.recovery: Use unittest discover with the exact tests directory and exact v651-v8 x1 filename.

incidents.candidate_method: Stop a compound PowerShell validation wrapper immediately when a child process fails.
incidents.failure: The compound validation wrapper continued after the failed unittest child and returned the success status of a later Git command.
incidents.recovery: Run the targeted test as a separate command and explicitly exit with its child status before any later validation step.

incidents.candidate_method: Run exact staged diff hygiene before commit and remove only the reported owner-local whitespace defect.
incidents.failure: The first exact staged diff check rejected a second blank line at the end of the new x1 validator.
incidents.recovery: Remove only the extra terminal blank line, restage the validator, and rerun the unchanged diff-hygiene gate.

incidents.candidate_method: Declare a count-bearing validation receipt as a manifest self-exclusion until its final write is complete.
incidents.failure: The first exact staged manifest replay found the x1 validation receipt changed after the manifest captured its earlier JSON count.
incidents.recovery: Add the validation receipt to the declared manifest self-exclusions, preserve owner-path coverage, and rerun exact staged parity.

incidents.candidate_method: Keep scanner-definition quarantine identical across builder and staged replay.
incidents.failure: The first independent staged privacy replay omitted the privacy receipt from its definition quarantine and misclassified its scanner-class descriptions as two confirmed hits.
incidents.recovery: Quarantine the builder and privacy receipt as exact scanner-definition surfaces, then rerun the unchanged five-class patterns.

incidents.candidate_method: Bind each Method Flow subcommand to its exact documented argument contract.
incidents.failure: The first Method Flow witness invocation supplied the method-record option and the runner refused it because witness requires its dedicated witness-file option.
incidents.recovery: Use record with the record option for method records and witness with the witness-file option for witness records.

incidents.candidate_method: Update a generated assertion at its generator source and authoritative count mirrors together.
incidents.failure: The first full x1 validator retry failed one of seven tests because the builder regenerated a stale twelve-negative assertion after the ledger reached thirteen.
incidents.recovery: Update the generator template, validator expectations, and direct generated test from the authoritative ledger before regenerating.
